body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-31 22:40Z, my own slip). When assigning an implementation item, the CODING OWNER must be a Sol or Opus session (Greg's rule, memory greg-decision-2026-10-22-code-authoring-override): only Sol or Opus write source or tests. Mergers keep coordination, intake and integration. Architects do design and review-of-design only, never landing review, execution or merges of patches. I assigned w-c1eba retention slice 1 to Termal::Merger2 (a Codex merger), and it correctly refused (mailbox 891850c6 #1395). The fix: Sol-8e1f is the coding owner, and Merger2 prepares the plan and intake. Before any assignment, check the session's role from its name (Sol-*/Opus* code; Merger*/Architect* don't), not only whether it's idle.
